subject.name: Recreational Therapists
subject.summary: Recreational therapists design and deliver sports, arts, games, or community activities in hospitals, nursing facilities, or community settings based on patient assessment and approved treatment goals; they observe responses, record progress, and adjust plans in collaboration with the medical team. Recreational therapy is part of the treatment plan, and ordinary recreation activity leadership, independent diagnosis, or unauthorized intervention must not be confused with it.
